items.question: What payment methods do you accept and how does the process work?
items.answer:
I accept payments via Wise and Nomad (US bank account), ideal for international transfers with lower fees, as well as Pix for clients based in Brazil. The workflow strictly follows a PRD (Product Requirement Document) defined before starting. To ensure security for both parties, I offer three payment models:

1. 50% upfront deposit and 50% upon final delivery.
2. Payment per Sprint (e.g., if the roadmap has 8 sprints, the total amount is split proportionally across each milestone).
3. Full upfront payment.

Development includes periodic alignment meetings (weekly or bi-weekly) to review each sprint's progress. Please note that access tokens and production credentials are only delivered upon project completion for mutual safety.

items.question: What types of services and projects do you offer?
items.answer: I provide end-to-end solutions ranging from initial prototyping and proof of concept (PoC) to validate ideas, up to full-scale custom software development, scalable web applications, and complete websites. I also offer data engineering/analysis and IT infrastructure consulting.

items.question: What tech stack do you use to build applications?
items.answer: I develop robust backend structures using Python, FastAPI, and Pydantic, integrated with PostgreSQL for database management. The entire application is containerized using Docker to ensure smooth deployment and scalability.

items.question: Do you provide documentation for the software you develop?
items.answer: I write comprehensive documentation before writing code. This blueprint ensures absolute transparency, eliminating vendor lock-in so any future engineer can seamlessly understand, maintain, or scale the system.

items.question: Will I receive the complete source code of the project?
items.answer: Yes, absolutely. Once the software is completed and delivered, you receive 100% full ownership of the clean, well-documented source code and all container configurations.

items.question: Can you help me deploy the application to a server?
items.answer: I deliver software fully containerized with Docker, making it production-ready for cloud providers (AWS, DigitalOcean, etc.). I can guide and assist you through the initial server setup and deployment phase.

items.question: Can the scope and budget be negotiated based on project needs?
items.answer: Yes. Every system has unique complexities. Base package prices serve as starting rates. Scope and final investment are tailored based on custom features, add-ons, and technical requirements.
